purpose: Compare the already verified 12-slot and 14-slot accounts on fixed, shared extreme-market intervals and quantify the arithmetic effect of the observed event returns.
2025_event: Use the two complete UTC days of October 10 and 11 defined in the previous original-account study. Use the existing account marks at both midnight boundaries.
2026_event: Among the complete UTC days with both the selected day and its following day covered in the January 1 through November 9 reference, choose the day of the greatest peak-to-trough drawdown on BTC USD-M five-minute marked openings. Read the reference market tape before checking NFI outcomes. Resolve exact ties by earliest date. Use the selected day and the following UTC day.
comparison: Keep the original positions, historical funding and wallet state. Compare the 8 and 15 bp accounts separately. Audit the marked equity difference with naturally closed campaign cash, changes in open-position PnL and the traded-price to mark valuation adjustment. No reoptimization or new trading rules.
sensitivity: Report the observed product of return multipliers from before and after the event by dividing the full window factor by its event factor. The arithmetic omits the observed factor only. There is no account with alternative trades or reinvestment without the event.
